name: Greenlight Capital Re, Ltd.
summary: Greenlight Capital Re, Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates as a property and casualty reinsurance company worldwide. It operates through Open Market and Innovations segments. The company offers casualty reinsurance, such as automobile liability and general liability.
